stacks.name: Back office in a box
stacks.for: Service businesses drowning in invoices and paper
stacks.flow: Quote and invoice clients in Invoice Ninja; every receipt, bill and contract is scanned into Paperless-ngx and auto-filed by Paperless-AI; contracts go out for signature through DocuSeal; n8n ties them together (for example, a signed contract creates the client and first invoice).

stacks.name: Sales and support team
stacks.for: Teams that sell and serve customers online
stacks.flow: Leads land in Twenty; prospects book calls through Cal; conversations from chat, email and messaging arrive in one Chatwoot inbox; listmonk sends the newsletter; n8n syncs contacts and logs conversations to the CRM.

stacks.name: Operations and inventory
stacks.for: Companies that buy, stock and ship physical goods
stacks.flow: Track parts, stock and purchase orders in InvenTree (or run the whole business in ERPNext); plan demand and replenishment in frePPLe; watch stock, service level and spend in Metabase; n8n sends low-stock and late-order alerts.

stacks.name: Private AI for the whole company
stacks.for: Teams that want ChatGPT-style help without sending data out
stacks.flow: Run models locally with Ollama behind Open WebUI for everyday questions; load policies, price lists and manuals into AnythingLLM so staff get answers with sources; build specific assistants (quote drafting, ticket replies) in Dify.
